description: This file defines the pSurface class, which is part of a charting library related to drawing and manipulating 3D surface charts, grid points, labels, contours, and other visual elements within a charting context.

classes.name: pSurface
classes.description: Class responsible for creating and managing surface charts, including grid setup, point addition, label writing, contour drawing, surface rendering, and missing data computation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a pSurface object with a reference to a chart object and default grid size.

methods.name: setGrid
methods.description: Defines the grid size for the surface chart and initializes the points matrix.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds or updates a data point on the grid, with optional forcing of overwrite.

methods.name: writeXLabels
methods.description: Writes X axis labels on the chart with formatting options.

methods.name: writeYLabels
methods.description: Writes Y axis labels on the chart with formatting options.

methods.name: drawContour
methods.description: Draws contour lines on the surface based on a specified threshold.

methods.name: drawSurface
methods.description: Renders the surface chart with optional shading, palette, and borders.

methods.name: computeMissing
methods.description: Interpolates missing data points in the grid based on nearest neighbors.

methods.name: getNearestNeighbor
methods.description: Calculates the nearest neighbor distance for a point in the grid.
